symbols.read: Bias flips back to bullish: price at 351.41 has reclaimed the 348.36 upper pivot that the prior read treated as overhead resistance, and the combined 1D+1H signal has upgraded from HOLD to BUY, confirming the prior corrective stance is now invalidated. The 348.36 level reverts to support and the entry is live with stop 346.54 below, targeting 370.91; the 1H trend up and last bar 343.19→343.55 support the move. The prior downside focus on 325.81 is shelved while price holds above 348.36. Invalidation is a close back below 348.36, which would restore the neutral-to-bearish read.

Bias has shifted from bearish to neutral-watch: price rallied to 261.98 and is now trading inside the bear FVG at 258.41–263.49, while the 1H trend has flipped up and the combined signal moved from SELL to HOLD — a clear change from the prior read where price was capped below 251.58 with the 1H down. The short setup is now further from trigger (roughly 17 points above entry at 244.72), with the 246.86 stop sitting well below current price, so the watching short is stale unless price rejects this FVG and rolls over. Key levels: resistance at the 265.34 upper pivot, support at 244.72; a push above 265.34 confirms the bullish flip and invalidates the bearish plan, while a rejection here that breaks back below 258.41 revives the short toward 244.72.

AVGO's bearish bias is now unconfirmed and fading: price jumped from 330.80 to 347.93, reclaiming the 338.03 FVG top and flipping the 1H trend up, which reverses the prior read's 1H/1D bearish alignment into a HOLD. The two bull FVGs at 324.80–325.20 and 327.82–329.48 have been filled and cleared, leaving no open FVGs, so the immediate downside magnet is gone. The 321.02 lower pivot still defines the short trigger toward 261.20, but with price 27 points above it and 1H rising, that entry is far less likely to fill soon; a break back below 338.03 would revive the bear case. Bias revised to neutral-to-bearish, watching rather than leaning short, with 321.02 the trigger and a sustained move above the 380.84 upper pivot the condition that would invalidate the bearish structure entirely.

The bias firms to BUY: price recovered from 740.55 to 740.85, the last 1H bar flipped positive (742.77→743.05), and the combined regime upgraded from HOLD to BUY, clearing the 742.51–743.66 supply that capped the prior read. With no open FVGs, the path to the 751.86 upper pivot is now unobstructed, and the 739.40 line cited previously remains the invalidation—losing it neutralizes the read and re-exposes 733.65/725.62. The SELL at 725.62 stays invalidated and irrelevant.

BRK.B has broken below the 549.96 upper pivot to 547.81, invalidating the prior entry-and-stop structure (stop 548.11) and flipping the combined 1D+1H signal from BUY to HOLD even as the 1D stays Bullish and the 1H trend up. The bias is now neutral-to-cautious rather than buy: price sits under the pivot with a fresh bear FVG at 548.31–548.57 acting as immediate overhead supply, while the cluster of bull FVGs (546.23–546.50, 544.67–545.12, 542.05–543.20, 538.58–539.20, 533.19–534.99) forms a stacked shelf beneath price that could cushion dips. The last 1H bar firmed to +0.23%, a marginal improvement but not enough to reclaim the pivot. Reclaiming and holding above 549.96 restores the bullish case toward 603.96; losing the 546.23–546.50 shelf opens the lower pivots and voids the up-trend read.

Price has edged lower to 79,828.70, extending the fade below the 80,451.18 lower pivot and confirming the bearish lean from the prior read; the 1H trend stays down and the 4H remains bearish, with the combined signal still HOLD and the setup INVALIDATED. The bull FVG at 80,332.71–80,362.00 cited previously is gone, replaced by a bear FVG at 80,119.85–80,141.16 now sitting just overhead — a structural shift that reinforces the downside rather than buffering it. Bias stays bearish while price holds below 80,451.18, with 76,004.36 the target; a push back above the 80,646.25 stop voids the lean.

Price extended lower to 2,308.30 from 2,328.26, staying below the 2,351.55 lower pivot, so the bearish structure holds and the prior read's bias is confirmed. The 1H downtrend persists, but the last bar's +0.17% move to 2,318.20 is a weak bounce that still fails to challenge the 2,352.9–2,354.32 bear FVG, and the NEUTRAL regime keeps conviction thin. The 2,176.48 target stands while price stays below 2,351.55; invalidation remains a reclaim of 2,351.55 that closes the FVG. The signal is still INVALIDATED, so this is a structural lean, not an active trigger.

Bias stays SELL, but the setup has weakened: price has bounced to 328.15, reclaiming the 322.00 lower pivot and pushing back above the 324.54 stop level that previously invalidated the plan, so the original entry/stop geometry no longer holds. The 1H trend is still down and the combined 1D+1H stack remains bearish, with the 326.49–327.01 and 322.64–322.74 bearish FVGs now below price and a fresh 318.86–319.20 gap beneath, while the 331.43–333.83 and 337.27–340.25 gaps sit overhead as supply. The bias is confirmed but the trade is on watch, not active — a sustained rejection from the 331.43–333.83 FVG keeps the short valid toward 284.60, while acceptance above 333.83 would clear immediate supply and break the bearish stack, invalidating the setup.

LLY has reclaimed the 1,321.21 upper pivot, with price now at 1,343.87 — a decisive reversal of the prior hold, so the bias shifts back to a confirmed long and the entry at 1,321.21 is live again with the stop at 1,309.40 now below price. The 1D direction and 1H trend both remain up, and the FVG cluster at 1,269–1,274 that was the prior battleground has been cleared with no open FVGs remaining, confirming the structure held. The last 1H bar pulled back from 1,281.12 to 1,275.27, so watch for a hold above 1,321.21 to keep the path toward the 1,511.21 target intact. Invalidation is a loss of 1,321.21 back below the pivot, which would re-dormant the setup; the NEUTRAL regime still argues for confirmation on a sustained hold rather than chasing the reclaim.

META's SELL bias is confirmed and now triggered: price at 630.72 has broken clean through the 639.69 entry and the 635.1–639.8 bearish FVG, converting the prior watching call into an active short with the 1H downtrend intact (633.82→630.72). The 648.42–650.38 FVG remains the upside cap, but the fresh 635.1–639.8 gap now sits overhead as resistance, so any bounce should stall below 639.8. Stop stays at 647.38, target 508.11, with the neutral regime the only caution flag. Invalidation is unchanged: a reclaim above 647.38 would push price back through both FVGs and undercut the short.

MSFT has triggered the prior WATCHING setup: price at 554.33 has reclaimed the 551.15 upper pivot, so the cautiously bullish bias is confirmed and the entry is now live rather than pending. The 1H trend remains up, but the last 1H bar slipped 532.25→531.30 (-0.18%) and the combined signal has eased from BUY to HOLD, while the bullish FVG at 524.58–526.32 is no longer listed as open — the support shelf beneath price has thinned, leaving 551.15 as the immediate line to hold. Bias stays bullish above the pivot, with stop 547.75 and target 605.05; invalidation is a decisive loss of 551.15 that runs the 547.75 stop, which would unwind the breakout and return the bias to neutral-to-bearish, with 497.25 the structural floor beyond that.

Bias stays bearish but conviction has weakened further: price at 228.14 has now cleared the 218.88–221.32 bearish FVG that previously capped upside, and with no open FVGs left on the chart, the overhead structure that defined the setup is gone. The 1H trend has flipped up while 1D direction remains bearish and the combined regime sits at HOLD, so the original short at 211.26 with stop 213.10 is deeply stale — price is roughly 17 points above the stop and the entry is far below spot. The bearish stance is now invalidated by the sustained hold above 221.32, and a push through the 243.37 upper pivot would confirm the downtrend is being reclaimed; only a drop back toward 211.26 would re-arm the short.

The prior SELL is invalidated: price has pushed below the 101.14 lower pivot to 100.30 rather than holding beneath it as an entry, and the combined 4H+1H bias has flipped to HOLD even though the 4H stays bearish and the 1H trend remains down. The fresh open bear FVG at 100.89–101.06 now sits overhead as supply, with 101.14–101.55 as the zone that would need reclaiming to restore a clean short setup and 93.08 still the downside target. Bias is neutral-to-softly-bearish while price stays under 101.14; a push back above 101.55 revives the bearish case, while a reclaim of 109.20 kills it outright.

TSLA's long bias holds but has softened: price at 393.83 has slipped from 395.89 yet remains above the 388.86 trigger, so the live entry is intact and the 1H trend is still up. The last 1H leg is 394.23→393.83 (-0.10%), a second consecutive mild stall that keeps price drifting toward the pivot rather than extending toward the 431.84 target. The 1D stays bullish and combined still reads HOLD, with the FVG field still empty so no overhead drag. Bias is confirmed long above 388.86; invalidation is a close back below 388.86 (stop 385.25), and a break of 345.88 would flip the broader structure bearish.

Price has extended below the 54.38 lower pivot to 53.90 and is now trading inside the 53.96–54.05 bearish FVG, a shift from the prior read where a bullish gap sat below price as a downside magnet. That gap has been replaced by a bearish one overhead, so the bearish structure is intact and the prior bias is confirmed, not revised. The 4H and 1H trends both remain down with the regime BEARISH and the combined read SELL, though the setup stays expired with no live entry. The 50.14 target remains the downside objective, and invalidation is unchanged: a sustained reclaim of 54.61 flips the short-term read neutral-to-bullish.

Price has drifted to 4,013.32, still above the 3,975.65 entry trigger, so the bearish watch remains unconfirmed and no position is live. The bias stays bearish — 4H bearish, regime BEARISH — but the combined signal has softened from SELL to HOLD and the 1H leg has flattened (4,012.68→4,013.32, +0.02%), a stall rather than the prior grind lower. A new bearish FVG has opened at 4,014.63–4,017.43 just overhead, which caps upside and keeps the drift toward entry intact. Key levels are unchanged: a clean break of 3,975.65 opens 3,809.07 with the stop at 3,984.48, and invalidation remains a sustained reclaim above 4,142.23. The prior read is confirmed on structure but revised on momentum — the approach to trigger has stalled and the combined signal no longer reads SELL.

The bearish bias holds but has weakened: the combined 4H+1H read has shifted from SELL to HOLD, and the 1.27 entry remains invalidated, so there is still no live position. Price at 1.29 is unchanged and still pinned below the 1.3075 reclaim level, with the 1H trend down and no open FVGs to fill. The setup stays a re-entry trigger: a sustained break of 1.27 reopens 1.15 with stop at 1.28, while reclaiming 1.3075 would neutralize the bearish case toward the 1.40 upper pivot. Invalidation for the bearish bias remains a hold back above 1.3075.
